$description: Theme-agnostic dimensions. The `target` and `focus` groups are Tier 4 SEALED INVARIANTS (PRD §10.2) — they are emitted into @layer aal.invariants and are not consumer-overridable, because removing them removes WCAG conformance.

target.$description: SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), Level AA — AR-09.

min.$description: Absolute floor. 24 CSS px is the normative AA minimum; px not rem deliberately, because a user shrinking their root font must not shrink the hit target below the legal minimum.

comfortable.$description: Default for AAL components. Exceeds AA and meets the AAA 2.5.5 / mobile guidance.

focus.$description: SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible + SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast — AR-05. Sized to also satisfy the AAA 2.4.13 Focus Appearance perimeter requirement, which the PRD reports as exceeding the AA target.

width.$description: Minimum perimeter thickness. Never 1px — it disappears on high-DPI displays.

offset.$description: Separates the ring from the control edge so both tones stay visible.

motion.$description: All of these resolve to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (AR-20).

reflow-min.$description: SC 1.4.10 Reflow — AR-17. Every component must be usable at this viewport width without two-dimensional scrolling.
